name: ooj-skills
description: Every loose skill that doesn't warrant a plugin of its own, in one bundle: conventional-commits (a Conventional Commits message reference), asd-ste100 (ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English), readme (generate a standard GitHub-style README from the repo), and popout (a throwaway single-file local web app to view, compare, or edit files in the browser) — pure skills, no hooks or scripts.
